items.exampleEn: The speaker's monotonous voice put half the audience to sleep.
items.exampleZh: 講者單調的聲音讓一半的聽眾都睡著了。

items.exampleEn: Can I speak candidly? I think the plan will fail.
items.exampleZh: 我可以直說嗎？我覺得這個計畫會失敗。

items.exampleEn: The wind tore viciously at our tent all night.
items.exampleZh: 狂風整晚兇猛地撕扯著我們的帳篷。

items.exampleEn: She was undaunted by the size of the task.
items.exampleZh: 她並沒有被這項任務的規模嚇倒。

items.exampleEn: The hotel is in an enviable position right next to the beach.
items.exampleZh: 這間飯店就在海灘旁邊，地點令人羨慕。
items.glossZh: 令人羨慕的；值得嚮往的

items.exampleEn: He handled his friend's mistake with tact and kindness.
items.exampleZh: 他圓融又體貼地處理了朋友犯的錯。

items.exampleEn: Thank you for your unwavering support over the years.
items.exampleZh: 謝謝你這些年來堅定不移的支持。

items.exampleEn: The tiny apartment felt claustrophobic after their big house.
items.exampleZh: 住過大房子之後，那間小公寓讓他們覺得壓迫窒息。
items.glossZh: （空間）壓迫窒息的；幽閉恐懼的

items.sentenceEn: Answering the same emails every day can be very monotonous.
items.sentenceZh: 每天回覆一樣的電子郵件，可能會非常單調。

items.audioEn: The guard dog barked viciously at us until its owner called it back.
items.audioZh: 那隻看門狗兇狠地對我們狂吠，直到主人把牠叫回去。
options: It ran away into the woods.
It slept by the front door.

items.sentenceEn: The two cats fought viciously over the last piece of fish.
items.sentenceZh: 那兩隻貓為了最後一塊魚兇狠地打了起來。

items.sentenceEn: Telling a friend that his idea is bad requires a lot of tact.
items.sentenceZh: 要告訴朋友他的點子不好，說話得很圓融才行。

items.stemEn: Even after failing the exam twice, he remained ____ and signed up again.
items.stemZh: 即使考試已經失敗兩次，他仍然不氣餒，又報名了一次。

items.stemEn: Her ____ support gave me the courage to start my own business.
items.stemZh: 她堅定不移的支持，給了我自己創業的勇氣。

items.passageEn: Lena has worked as a guide in a famous cave system for ten years. Friends say she has an enviable job, and she candidly admits that she still loves it. It is not always easy, though. Some visitors find the narrow tunnels claustrophobic and want to turn back, so she needs great tact to keep them calm. Repeating the same facts six times a day could become monotonous, but she keeps her talks fresh and a little spontaneous. Last year, heavy rain filled the lower tunnels with water, and the caves closed for a month. Undaunted, Lena used the time to study the rocks and plan a new tour. Her unwavering passion has made her one of the most popular guides in the area.
items.passageZh: Lena 在一處著名的洞穴群當導覽員已經十年了。朋友說她的工作令人羨慕，她也坦白承認自己仍然很愛這份工作。不過，這份工作並不總是輕鬆。有些遊客覺得狹窄的通道讓人喘不過氣，想要回頭，所以她需要非常圓融地安撫他們。一天把同樣的內容講六遍可能會變得單調，但她讓自己的解說保持新鮮，還帶點即興。去年，大雨讓下層通道積滿了水，洞穴關閉了一個月。Lena 沒有氣餒，利用這段時間研究岩石，規劃了一條新的導覽路線。她堅定不移的熱情，讓她成為當地最受歡迎的導覽員之一。

questions.questionZh: 有些遊客為什麼想回頭？
options: 覺得狹窄的通道讓人喘不過氣

questions.questionZh: 洞穴關閉的那個月，Lena 做了什麼？
options: 到國外的洞穴參觀學習
研究岩石，規劃新的導覽路線

items.promptZh: 她能在家工作，又常常出國旅行，她的生活真令人羨慕。
referenceEn: She can work from home and travel abroad often; her life is enviable.
She has an enviable life: she works from home and often travels abroad.
rubricZh: 「令人羨慕的」用 enviable，可放 be 動詞後或名詞前（例如 an enviable life）
「在家工作」可寫，例如 work from home、work at home 等
說的是現在的狀況，時態配合內容（例如 can work、has、travels）

items.promptZh: 那隻狗對主人的忠誠堅定不移，牠每天都在車站等主人回家。
referenceEn: The dog's loyalty to its owner was unwavering; it waited at the station for him every day.
With unwavering loyalty, the dog waited at the station for its owner every day.
rubricZh: 「堅定不移」用 unwavering（例如 unwavering loyalty、was unwavering 等）
「等主人回家」可寫，例如 waited for its owner、waited for the owner to come home 等
時態配合內容（例如 was、waited、is、waits 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確
